samples.question: The image contains several small stacked-bar tiles. In every tile two short horizontal bars sit one above the other with clear background between them. Exactly one tile is the switch tile: a short teal trunk stub rises or falls from the middle of that tile and touches exactly one of its two bars, and the touched bar is teal while the other bar is gray with a visible gap between the stub and that gray bar. Exactly one other tile is the pad tile: its upper and lower bars are orange and purple in some order. Every remaining tile is an all-gray decoy and means nothing. The trunk continues to the pad on the matching side of the pad tile: the upper channel reaches the upper pad and the lower channel reaches the lower pad. Which pad does the trunk reach? Answer orange or purple.
